headline: Ortin Global files AGM scrutiny report and voting results
hook: AGM voting results submitted to exchanges
summary: Ortin Global Limited has submitted the scrutinizer's report and voting results for its Annual General Meeting held on September 30, 2026, to the stock exchanges. This is a routine regulatory compliance filing required for listed companies. The disclosure provides the outcome of shareholder resolutions voted upon during the meeting. Indian retail investors holding shares in the company can review the voting patterns for corporate governance insights.
why_it_matters: Routine compliance filing with no immediate impact on stock price.

headline: Ortin Global Limited concludes its annual general meeting
hook: Routine procedural approval at Ortin Global
summary: Ortin Global Limited has informed the stock exchange about the proceedings of its Annual General Meeting held on September 30, 2026. The filing is a standard corporate compliance update regarding routine shareholder resolutions. Such procedural filings have minimal immediate impact on the company's stock price or financial performance. Retail investors holding the stock can note the completion of the mandatory annual meeting without expecting near-term market movement.
why_it_matters: No immediate financial impact for retail shareholders
